steps.code:
# Parse all notes: extract date from title and habits from content.
import re

parsed = []
for nc in note_contents:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', nc['title'])
    if not m:
        print("No date in title:", nc['title'])
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines: each line "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in nc['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            val = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if val in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit] = val
    parsed.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits, 'note_id': nc['note_id']})

# Check habit order from first note
first_habits = list(parsed[0]['habits'].keys())
print("First note habits:", first_habits)
print("Number of parsed notes:", len(parsed))

# Verify all notes have same habits in same order
consistent = True
for p in parsed:
    if list(p['habits'].keys()) != first_habits:
        consistent = False
        print("Inconsistent habits in note", p['note_id'], list(p['habits'].keys()))
        break
print("Consistent:", consistent)
